mile of the bridge as the road will be covered by swift moving
river current.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 6:45 PM CDT Sunday the stage was 9.5 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 7.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 6:45 PM CDT Sunday was 9.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river will fall below flood stage late Tuesday
morning to 4.6 feet Wednesday evening.
- Flood stage is 8.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 9.5
feet on 03/17/1990.

deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/lix.  Click on
the Rivers and Lakes menu for forecasts and observations.

properties.description:

Washington...

forecast.

* WHERE...Stehekin River at Stehekin.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 20.5 feet, water inundates some properties and
overtops the temporary corduroy bridge. Company Creek Road
inundated at northern end. Battalion Creek culverts are beginning
to be overtopped. Water begins damaging Wood Road.

- At 10:30 AM PDT Sunday the stage was 20.4 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 19.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is currently below flood stage and is in
action stage. However, it will then rise above flood stage
Tuesday morning to 20.9 feet late Wednesday morning. It will
continue to fluctuate between below and above flood stage
through the week.
- Flood stage is 20.5 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
